notes: No tuition fee is stated for this programme on the supplied pages, so the tuition fact is omitted. The programme's own page does not state an application deadline for non-EU/international applicants, and the Study Finder page refers applicants to the annual admission process without giving a dated deadline. The application channel is therefore left out: the pages do not specify whether a self-financed foreign applicant applies via the university's own online system or via the Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship.
